notes: The competing reading fuses `אַף כִּי` into one *How much less … when* unit; the split is taken because the ASV writes a separate subordinator that `כִּי` independently licenses under rule 55, so each morpheme has a rendering of its own and rule 2 prefers the split.

`לְפָנָיו` → *is before*: preposition and construct noun share one rendering under rule 30, the construction-supplied copula joining the whole expression without defeating the one-rendering condition; the suffix is no part of the fusion and takes its own *him*.
The marginal alternative rendering was read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text governs.
